main_text.p: Glorificari, Glorificare se: Pyhal כִּבַּד idem. Pihel כַּבֵּד. Hiphil הִכְבִּיד Aggravavit, Amplificavit, Honoravit. Hithpahel הִתְכַּבֵּד Honorare se, Numerosum se efficere.
כָּבֵד m. Gravis, Numerosus, Dives: item, Jecur, a Gravitate sic dictum. Est enim viscerum gravissimum: plural. כְּבֵדִים Graves.
כָּבֵד m. כְּבֵדוּת f. Gravitas, Multitudo, Copia.
נִכְבָּד Honoratus, Honorabilis: plur. נִכְבָּדִים & נִכְבָּדִים : Fœm. נִכְבָּדוֹת .
כִּבֵּס Lavit, Abluit. Pyhal כֻּבַּס Lavari. At illud, הִכָּבֵּס Lavari, Levit.13.56: formam habet ex Hophal & Hithpahel.
מְכַבֵּס כּוֹבֵס m. Fullo, lotor pannorum.
כַּבִּיר m. Validus, Potens. Semel כַּאֲבִיר cum redundante, plur. כַּבִּירִים .

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are small and partly smudged by stains on the scan; they are transcribed as best read. The entry "Levit.13.56" and the abbreviations are as printed. Stains cover the left and lower edges of the page.
